title: Discovery Channel - Large Asteroid Impact Simulation
summary: A Discovery Channel computer simulation of a large asteroid impact on Earth, showing the scale of the devastation. It sits in a broader context of early Earth impacts and the moon-forming collision.
why: HN commenters link it to convey the scale of asteroid impacts, such as the one that killed the dinosaurs, or of ejecta and tsunamis.

quote.text: This discovery channel video might help put things in perspective
